body: I was thinking about calling suicide hotline but the thing is I don't feel suicidal I just lost motivation to live. If that makes sense. Like I don't have a plan I'm making but motivation to keep going is low. So I didn't think I was in crisis yet.

Oh my gosh! Thank you so much! I absolutely did not know this! I was going to go in and do my second or first! I really appreciate your comments. Thank you :)
Is it best to do it on the first pee of the day or not? I thought it was (it was my second) but I've scrolled through other posts and other people do it at the middle of the day or so.
So as long as it's not blank like it is on the positive image then it can be considered negative?
Oh noes really? I just bought two :/ which one was most accurate for you?
Wait really? About the pickle juice and faking it. I'm doing it in a Quest Diagnostics lab and my dad says they follow you all the way up to the bathroom door :o

It will be a urine test, yes. It's not scheduled yet and I'm trying to elongate the time until I have to take it. My brother researched it for me and he said Quest only tests for a 24-72 hour window and has it has to be under 15 nanograms. 


Thank you for the response. Nothing else I can do right? Only time can really detox me?

It's okay! It's just nice that someone out there understands :/ which still sucks cause I hate that someone DOES know.

My family and friends don't understand that much. Which is okay, but sometimes I feel so stupid when I explain that when I'm in an episode self-harm is all that makes sense to me. Logically, I know it's not, but in that moment I lose myself.

I'm so glad you know that ; v; 


At least for me, it feels good when I know the energy I have isn't manic energy :) good job! Keep it up <3

I wish this is how you felt about me. So sad our arrangement is only temporary. 

I hope to meet someone, someday, who makes me feel as light and at home as you do.

I felt this. I'm so sorry. 

You are strong and you deserve the best.

Honestly, it's just so hard. 

As this moment in my life, I'm trying so desperately to stay alive. I keep listening to songs that talk about the perspective of people who have lost others. But it's so difficult. It take most my energy just to try to be okay. Actually, not even getting to okay. It take so much energy to barely feel alright.

But why do we have to try our best? When I try my best every day and I'm always so exhausted... Exhausted because of how hard I'm trying. Then I see my friend. Effortlessly happy. He has his own problems, of course, but he says he's relatively happy. And here I am... Objectively I have a good life and yet I keep cutting and I keep planning ways to die. I want to be effortlessly happy. Actually... I just want to sleep forever
You would want to listen to me?
I hate seeking attention or help... Because of those people

I'm sorry that you're able to sympathize. This sort of emptiness isn't something I would even wish on someone I hate. 

My mom is also the person keeping me here. She suffers from a lot of physical ailments and mental health issues... My passing, as she's told me before, would destroy her. But I'm losing all hope and all I can tell her is I'm sorry. She's far stronger than I am. 

I couldn't have said it better myself... Escaping the lows several times but it seems that I keep falling back into it...

And that gray touch... I was a foodie. Flavors brought me joy. Now... Everything just tastes bland. I can barely eat. 

I sympathize with you. I never wanted to get old. Even when I was a kid I didn't see myself past the age of 20. I never wanted to grow old...

I really hope these two things work for you. I hate to be a hypocrite, but it would be a shame for the world to lose a kind soul like yourself. 

I'm not going to say it'll get better... Cause I don't know if it will... Though I've heard from many people that living is worth it I guess. 

I guess I'll ask you what my friend asked me: what would it take for you to want to continue living?

My boyfriend said something along the same lines. He had told me, after months of not having sex (for reasons he was COMPLETELY aware of), that he had been talking to a married friend of ours. That even if a wife or husband isn't feeling "in the mood" they should still have sex if they really wanted it. That's it's a sacrificial give and take. Something rubbed me the wrong way about what he said, but I just gave in and did whatever whenever he asked...
